description: Department of Inland Revenue - Notice in relation to the any period for which interest on a blended loan
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal notice issued under Section 31(3) of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. It specifies a regulatory period for compounding interest on blended loans based on generally accepted accounting principles. The content involves the exercise of regulatory powers and the specification of legal/accounting requirements, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
